sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive and value-oriented sectors are securing solid footing as Financials and Consumer Defensive surge, while Basic Materials and Healthcare experience sharp near-term rank deteriorations.

The market is showing highly concentrated strength, with only 3 of 11 groups maintaining "all-green" status across all timeframes (weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD). Energy continues to hold the overall momentum crown, but defensive rotation is the primary narrative. Financials and Consumer Defensive are leading the charge higher, capturing both rank improvements and all-green status. 

Conversely, cyclical and growth laggards are failing to find traction. Consumer Cyclical remains anchored at the bottom of the momentum rankings, while sudden rank drops in Basic Materials and Healthcare suggest a rapid repositioning away from these spaces over the last five sessions.

## Strength
* **Concentrated Breadth:** Only 3 of 11 industry groups are currently "all-green" across all measured time horizons (weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD).
* **Defensive & Value Leaders:** Real Estate (momentum 0.68), Financials (momentum 0.68), and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.50) constitute the exclusive list of all-green sectors.
* **Energy Dominance:** Despite not being in the all-green category, Energy remains the absolute momentum leader with a score of 0.82 (ranked 1st YTD).

## Movers & Momentum
* **Financials Surge:** Financials represent the biggest winner of the week, jumping 3 spots to rank 6th with a strong momentum score of 0.68.
* **Defensive Bid:** Consumer Defensive gained 2 spots to climb to 5th place (momentum 0.50), while Utilities ticked up 1 spot to rank 7th (momentum 0.40).
* **Sharp Declines:** Basic Materials and Healthcare suffered the worst weekly setbacks, both tumbling 3 spots to land at rank 8 (momentum 0.23) and rank 9 (momentum 0.52), respectively.
* **Persistent Laggards:** Consumer Cyclical remains the weakest link in the market, stuck at rank 11 with a momentum score of just 0.20.

## Divergences
* **Tech vs. Financials Momentum:** Technology sits at rank 2 YTD, but its momentum score (0.63) has now fallen behind the lower-ranked Financials (rank 6, momentum 0.68) and Real Estate (rank 4, momentum 0.68).
* **Healthcare Disconnect:** Healthcare maintains a relatively healthy mid-tier momentum score of 0.52, yet it suffered a severe 3-spot drop in rank over the last five sessions, signaling a rapid short-term loss of institutional support.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing and Consumer Electronics anchor a robust core of 31 "all-green" industries, while Staffing & Employment Services surges and defensive assets like Silver, Aerospace & Defense, and Uranium experience sharp weekly declines.

US industry breadth remains healthy with 31 of 144 groups maintaining all-green status across all time horizons. Energy and industrials are showing sustained leadership, led by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing and Railroads. Concurrently, a powerful rotation is underway into labor and real estate, highlighted by a massive five-day rank improvement in Staffing & Employment Services and steady gains in industrial and diversified REITs.

Conversely, momentum is rapidly fading from precious metals, defense, and alternative energy. Silver, Aerospace & Defense, and Uranium all suffered severe rank drops over the last five sessions, joining long-term laggards like Information Technology Services and Pharmaceutical Retailers at the bottom of the momentum curve. 

## Strength
* **Refining and Electronics Lead:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.98) and Consumer Electronics (momentum 0.90) remain the market's strongest performers, holding top sustained ranks and all-green profiles.
* **Broad-Based Breadth:** 31 out of 144 industry groups are positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD, featuring high-momentum sectors like Staffing & Employment Services (0.86), REIT - Healthcare Facilities (0.85), and Railroads (0.85).
* **Sustained Winners:** Textile Manufacturing, Banks - Diversified, and Food Distribution continue to demonstrate long-term structural strength, maintaining their positions in the top 36 industries across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Labor and Real Estate Surge:** Staffing & Employment Services jumped 34 spots to rank 13 with 0.86 momentum, while REIT - Industrial gained 11 spots to reach rank 38 (momentum 0.73).
* **Commodity and Defense Collapse:** Silver plunged 35 spots (rank 99, momentum 0.25), Aerospace & Defense fell 33 spots (rank 103, momentum 0.18), and Uranium dropped 30 spots (rank 121, momentum 0.13).
* **Bottom-Tier Laggards:** Information Technology Services (momentum 0.05, rank 142) and Pharmaceutical Retailers (momentum 0.07, rank 144) show virtually no signs of recovery, anchoring the bottom of the momentum spectrum.

## Divergences
* **Fading Momentum:** Biotechnology (momentum 0.60) fell 25 spots in five days, signaling a sharp reversal. Similarly, Drug Manufacturers - General (momentum 0.62) and Healthcare Plans (momentum 0.70) both slipped 5 spots, indicating early-stage distribution in healthcare.
* **Emerging Turnarounds:** Shell Companies jumped 23 spots despite low momentum (0.39), while Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+15 spots, momentum 0.48) and Specialty Business Services (+13 spots, momentum 0.50) are rapidly rising from depressed levels.
